name: golden
description: Seed golden set for the Northwind Tools fixture KB. Source ids are fixture document slugs, resolved to real KnowledgeSource ids at run time.

cases.question: How much is the Team plan per month?
cases.referenceAnswer: The Team plan is $99 per month.

cases.question: How many seats does the Scale plan include?
cases.referenceAnswer: The Scale plan includes 50 seats.

cases.question: How long do I have to get a full refund?
cases.referenceAnswer: Any plan can be refunded in full within 30 days of the initial purchase.

cases.question: What encryption do you use for data at rest?
cases.referenceAnswer: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256.

cases.question: What is the API rate limit?
cases.referenceAnswer: 600 requests per minute per workspace.

cases.question: How many rows can a CSV import have?
cases.referenceAnswer: A CSV import is limited to 50,000 rows per file.

cases.question: When is support available?
cases.referenceAnswer: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm UK time. There is no weekend support.

cases.question: How often are encryption keys rotated?
cases.referenceAnswer: Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days.

cases.question: How are webhooks signed?
cases.referenceAnswer: With HMAC-SHA256, sent in the X-Northwind-Signature header, computed over the raw request body.

cases.question: How long before a team invitation expires?
cases.referenceAnswer: An invitation expires after seven days and can be resent.

cases.question: How long do you keep backups?
cases.referenceAnswer: Backups are retained for 35 days and then destroyed.

cases.question: Are you SOC 2 certified?
cases.referenceAnswer: Yes, Northwind Tools is SOC 2 Type II certified.

cases.question: What happens if my payment fails?
cases.referenceAnswer: The card is retried three times over seven days; the account stays active during that window, then goes read-only until a payment succeeds.

cases.question: Which regions can I host my data in?
cases.referenceAnswer: us-east or eu-west, chosen at signup.

cases.question: Which integrations do you support?
cases.referenceAnswer: Slack, Zapier, HubSpot and Salesforce.

cases.question: I paid annually four months ago. Can I get money back?
cases.referenceAnswer: Annual plans are refunded pro rata for whole unused months after the 30-day window, so roughly eight months of the annual price would be refunded.

cases.question: I'm in Germany and bought an annual Team plan 20 days ago. What refund am I entitled to?
cases.referenceAnswer: Day 20 falls inside the 30-day full-refund window, which is more generous than the EU statutory 14 days, so the annual Team plan ($990) is refunded in full.

cases.question: We're on Scale and pay by bank transfer. How do we get a refund?
cases.referenceAnswer: Scale customers can be invoiced by bank transfer on net-30 terms, and refunds follow the same 30-day full-refund policy, requested by emailing billing@northwind.example.

cases.question: If my payment keeps failing, do I lose my team members?
cases.referenceAnswer: No. After three failed retries the workspace becomes read-only, but nothing is deleted, and roles and members remain.

cases.question: Can I sign up for Scale with my gmail address and invite 60 people?
cases.referenceAnswer: No on both counts: Scale requires a verified company domain rather than a personal email, and Scale includes 50 seats with no overage, so a 60th seat is blocked.

cases.question: We handle EU health data. Can we use you in eu-west?
cases.referenceAnswer: Data can be hosted in eu-west, but Northwind is not HIPAA compliant and does not sign BAAs, so health data is not supported.

cases.question: What would I be paying each month for the mid-tier plan?
cases.referenceAnswer: The Team plan is $99 per month.

cases.question: What's the process for getting my money back?
cases.referenceAnswer: Email billing@northwind.example from the account address; approval takes two business days and the money arrives in five to ten business days.

cases.question: How many calls can I make before you start throttling me?
cases.referenceAnswer: 600 requests per minute per workspace, after which you get an HTTP 429.

cases.question: Where does my information physically live?
cases.referenceAnswer: In whichever region you chose at signup, us-east or eu-west; it does not leave that region.

cases.question: Can I force everyone on my team to use an authenticator app?
cases.referenceAnswer: Yes, an owner can enforce two-factor authentication workspace-wide.

cases.question: If I move to a cheaper plan, when does it kick in?
cases.referenceAnswer: Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.

cases.question: waht is yuor refudn policy?
cases.referenceAnswer: Full refund within 30 days of purchase; after that, annual plans are refunded pro rata.

cases.question: how do you handel encrpytion of my data?
cases.referenceAnswer: TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest, with keys rotated every 90 days.

cases.question: how do i verfy a webhok signatuer?
cases.referenceAnswer: Verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Northwind-Signature header, computed over the raw request body.

cases.question: wat hours is sopport open on the weeknd
cases.referenceAnswer: There is no weekend support on any plan; support runs Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm UK time.
